responsibility: Implements GCC’s legacy fixed-width 2×HOST_WIDE_INT integer arithmetic used mainly by constant folding and numeric helper code before or alongside wide-int. It provides the out-of-line operations for the double_int type—addition, subtraction, negation, multiplication, division, shifts, comparisons, min/max selection, decimal dumping, and GMP conversion helpers—operating on explicit high/low words and tracking signed versus unsigned overflow behavior where required.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-line behavior for the double_int interface declared in gcc/double-int.h, including multiword arithmetic, comparisons, decimal dumping, and GMP import/export routines; unlike the header, this file contains the executable algorithms rather than the type definition and inline API surface.
